Diego (partnerships): quick heads-up — Datadog wants a conformance run of our embedded telemetry exporter against their dashboard templates on SI GPU hardware next Tue. Can we support a 1-hr smoke/metric validation window? :eyes:
Priya (eng-runtime): probably yes, we need the sample app, the exporter build, and the DD API key scope. Any constraints on sequence lengths or traffic shape?
Sam (datadog-integration): we'll provide a trimmed dashboard json and an OTLP collector config. Traffic shape: 10–20 traces/s, some 8–12 KB payloads, a few long running spans to test KV cache tags.
Liam (eng-ml): ok to simulate. need model binary size and any special kernel patches?
Diego (partnerships): SI partner will run the model binary; we just need to validate telemetry and dashboards. They can provide a short runbook for the sample app.
Priya (eng-runtime): can we get the sample app container and a minimal compose? Drop the compose and we can run here in our staging rack first.
Sam (datadog-integration): attaching the config we'll share in the run — will send as link in a follow up. It includes an example OTLP endpoint and snippet to validate traces quickly.
Ava (product): objective: verify traces and metrics surface in the packaged dashboard, alert queries trigger, and no exporter memory spikes for 30m. If green, we go to joint announcement checklist.
Priya (eng-runtime): plan: 1) run in staging (30m) 2) iterate on exporter flags (batching/timeout) 3) run on SI hardware (partner) 4) capture dashboard snapshot + perf metrics. Who owns snapshot?
Diego (partnerships): partnerships owns the press-ready snapshot + partner quote. Eng to provide perf slices and a short log strip.
Liam (eng-ml): small note — when running model we should set MAX_SEQ=1024 to exercise cache evictions.
Sam (datadog-integration): ack. I'll add a dashboard tile that highlights cache eviction rate and exporter queue depth.
Priya (eng-runtime): throwing a quick validation command here to sanity-check exporter endpoint (run in staging):
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @sample_trace.pbf
# expect HTTP/1.1 200 and a short ack in logs
```
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/embedded-exporter:v1.4.2 to staging succeeded — logs: /deploys/3456789012
Diego (partnerships): awesome. Actions: Sam to share config + dashboard json by EOD, Priya/Liam to run staging smoke Wed AM, partner run Tue next week. I'll ping legal for quote signoff. :rocket:
Ava (product): please add a single-line success criteria to the run doc: "Traces & metrics appear in dashboard within 30s of exporter start; no >20% memory growth over 30m."
Priya (eng-runtime): added to run checklist. I'll post the staging run results in this thread after Wed.
Diego (partnerships): thanks team, will follow up with partner scheduling. :thumbsup:
